credential.title: API key import
credential.boundary: Imports explicitly declared API keys only. No subscription caches, OAuth or browser credentials are read, and no authentication helper runs. Raw values never pass through this UI or ordinary RPC.
credential.configuration: API key in the selected configuration
credential.environment: Environment variable declared by the source
credential.consent: I confirm this is a reusable API key, not a subscription or session token, and authorize reading and importing it into the selected target account.
credential.file_notice: The target policy permits file storage. The key stays in this account's private credential file. File permissions are not system-keychain encryption.
credential.keyring_notice: The key is stored in the target operating-system credential store; configuration holds a reference. Failure does not silently downgrade to plaintext files.

phases.conflict: Later edits found; current values preserved

row_description: Import model connections, MCP, compatible skills and instructions while preserving existing content
title: Migrate to KCoder
description: Find Claude Code or Codex work assets on the selected runtime target, review them, then save. Source files stay unchanged.
scope: Supports model connections, MCP, and compatible skills, commands and instructions. Complex execution rules, plugins, history and complete batch migration are still in development and are not counted as successful.
asset_enable: Enable after import for eligible new conversations
asset_native: Native project instructions already read this AGENTS.md. Reuse the original without duplicate injection; undo never deletes the source.
asset_notice: Preserves project scope and never runs resource scripts. Unsupported tool restrictions, dynamic commands and conditional rules require adaptation before import.
asset_review: Import {{name}} with its source and scope. Keep existing assets and do not run embedded commands.
asset_project: Scope: the original project and its subdirectories, subject to project trust.
asset_enabled: Enabled for eligible new conversations. Existing conversations keep their current snapshots.
asset_disabled: Saved inactive. Skills can be enabled in skill management; complete instruction and memory management is still in development.
saved_asset_description: Imported {{count}} item(s). Saving does not prove the instructions work in a real task.
target_error: Could not load runtime targets. Refresh and try again.
remote: This view inspects the selected target account. Use the cross-device or local-file entry for other sources, then review before saving.
project: Also inspect configuration in the current trusted project
discovery_problem: Unable to inspect this source. Check its file permissions and supported configuration format.
empty: No configuration was found. Check that the source app is installed for the selected target account.
configure: Choose content and fill in missing information
mcp_private: Private source environment values and headers are not written to public settings. Servers missing required values remain pending and cannot start without them. When reusing an MCP server, select only missing fields; existing private values are preserved.
mcp_enable: Enable for newly started conversations only
mcp_review: Save MCP server {{name}} with its environment references, working directory and tool restrictions. This does not start the server or validate its connection.
mcp_disabled_notice: Saved disabled; connection is unverified. Complete its configuration and enable it in the target's MCP management page.
mcp_enabled_notice: Enabled for newly started conversations. No server was started or validated during migration.
saved_mcp_description: {{count}} server definitions migrated. This does not prove connection or authorization succeeded.
unsupported_item: Migration is not yet supported for this content type
name: Imported connection name
limits: Use the model's actual limits. Do not substitute an automatic compaction threshold.
review_description: Save {{name}} while preserving existing connections and the default model. No source program or connection validation will run.
credentials: Credentials are not copied automatically. Configure credentials, confirm model capabilities and validate the connection in model settings after saving.
unknown: The previous submission may have executed. Retry reconciles the same durable plan without creating duplicate content.
saved_description: {{count}} items migrated. Saving configuration does not prove login or connection validation succeeded.
cancelled_description: Further migration has stopped. Confirmed saved items remain recorded.
unconfirmed_cancelled: A previous write remains unconfirmed and retry has stopped. Review the corresponding settings or asset manager; cancellation does not mean its changes were rolled back.
rolled_back_description: The owned import was undone while preserving the original work assets.
rollback_unknown_description: Refresh or reconcile and retry the same rollback plan. It will not restart the import or delete unrelated changes.
rollback_conflict_description: Later edits were found. No content was deleted. Review the corresponding settings or asset manager.
rollback_description: Only an owned, unchanged import can be undone. Later edits are preserved and reported as a conflict.
page: Page {{page}}, at most 10 items per page
issue: Some fields need manual review. This item will not be enabled automatically.

phases.published: Private values saved; MCP connectivity not verified
phases.unknown: Outcome unconfirmed; continue the same plan

batch_mcp.boundary: Only selected source literals are saved and undone with this batch. Values never enter the page, source commands are not executed, and connection is not tested; activation still requires explicit selection. Reused MCP servers can receive missing fields while retaining existing private values. Undo restores the binding from before this extension.
batch_mcp.grouped: These fields share a publication group with this batch configuration. Use the batch controls to save, resume or undo them together.
batch_mcp.remaining: {{count}} required fields are still missing, so the MCP cannot connect yet. After saving, reuse this MCP in a new batch to explicitly add missing fields.
batch_mcp.read_failed: Private-field plans could not be read. Refresh to reconcile; submitted saves are never replayed automatically.
batch_mcp.unsupported: This target does not support private values in an initial batch. Save definitions disabled or update the target before trying again.
batch_mcp.consent_pending: Confirm consent for the selected MCP private fields, or clear those field selections.

history.group_parent_elsewhere: The parent is on another page or was not discovered. Each visible artifact requires its own selection.
history.group_explicit: Each artifact keeps its own title and selection. Selecting a parent does not select its agents or forks.
history.title: History archives
history.boundary: Save a selected source transcript as an immutable archive on this target. Source files stay unchanged; historical tools, approvals and tasks are never replayed.
history.partial: Discovery was incomplete. Unreadable, unrecognized or oversized entries may require attention.
history.source_blocked: This file exceeds the current import budget.
history.issues: {{count}} record(s) need review; parsing does not confirm complete compatibility.
history.failed: The archive job stopped. Refresh its state before resuming.
history.normalized_boundary: The original transcript is saved and normalized. Inspect attachments and the current branch, then explicitly check whether a new continuation can be created.
history.idle: No parser is running. Waiting to continue.
history.worker_unknown: Execution ownership cannot be confirmed. Refresh before continuing.

transcript.title: Archived conversation
transcript.boundary: Read-only source order, including old branches and control records. Links, images, widgets and historical tools do not access the current workspace. This is not the effective continuation context.
transcript.read_failed: The archive could not be read. Refresh and try the same page again.
transcript.partial: This page was captured from partial parsing progress. Refresh to see newly committed records.
transcript.empty: No parsed records on this page.
transcript.hidden: The source marked this record as internal.
transcript.sidechain: The source marked this as a side chain.
transcript.compacted: The source marked this as a compaction summary.
transcript.diagnostic: The source contains a compatibility diagnostic.
transcript.attachment: Attachment reference preserved; content not imported yet
transcript.opaque: Opaque source content preserved; not used as active content

branch.boundary: Reconstructs the source parent chain and supported compaction/rollback window. Source tools remain historical facts; this does not approve continuation.
branch.view_boundary: Read-only reconstructed branch. Replacements and omitted context affect this view only; the original archives stay unchanged.
branch.related_boundary: Only explicitly selected, parsed Codex archives on this target may satisfy a paginated parent prefix. Unrelated source instances cannot be joined.
branch.inactive: Reconstruction is incomplete and no task is currently running. Continue explicitly.
branch.structural_complete: The selected parent path/window was reconstructed structurally. Attachments, unsupported content and safe continuation require separate checks.
branch.incomplete: The source path/window is incomplete. Available records are read-only; do not treat this as safe continuation.
branch.draft: Parent archive choices changed. Prepare this selection before viewing its branch.
branch.failed: The branch could not be read or reconstructed. Refresh its state before trying the same view again.

branch_tools.title: Historical tool correlation
branch_tools.boundary: Correlates calls and results retained in this branch only. Missing results stay unknown; this does not run tools or prove their success.
branch_tools.failed: Tool records could not be correlated or read. Refresh this view before retrying.
branch_tools.empty: No tool records in this branch.

attachment.title: Historical attachment
attachment.unavailable: This attachment is not available for import.
attachment.failed: Attachment processing failed. Refresh its state before retrying.
attachment.idle: Processing stopped. You can continue this attachment.

tool_attachments.title: Tool-result attachments
tool_attachments.unstructured: The result is plain text; it was not reparsed as an attachment array.
tool_attachments.excluded_count: {{unknown}} unknown · {{opaque}} opaque items. The original result remains archived.
tool_attachments.failed: Could not inspect the collection. Refresh before retrying.

continuation.title: Create a continuation session
continuation.boundary: The created session stays idle. Opening does not send a prompt. Only your new request starts a turn; prior operations are not replayed.
continuation.default_model: Uses the target’s current default model and session template.
continuation.failed: Preparation could not complete. Refresh the receipt and review the required actions.
continuation.processed: {{bytes}} bytes processed in the current item
continuation.estimate: History locally estimated at {{tokens}} tokens; the actual turn still checks its budget.

stages.imported: Session saved; awaiting your new request

continuation.open_failed: Could not open the saved conversation. Refresh and try again.

conversation_history.title: Imported conversation
conversation_history.reconstructed: Continuation context was reconstructed from readable source records. Encrypted summaries, if present, cannot be restored; historical reasoning summaries are omitted, old tools are not enabled, some historical search and tool-discovery details remain only in the original archive, some earlier tool records may remain only in the original archive, long tool results may be excerpted, and historical attachments are not automatically sent to the model.
conversation_history.boundary: This is the selected historical branch. Recorded tools and results are for reference; new requests use your current model and permissions.
conversation_history.unavailable: The saved source history could not be read. Your current conversation is still available.

search.placeholder: Find in saved text and tool results
search.failed: Could not search this history. Run a new search to restart.
search.unsupported: {{count}} item(s) have an unsupported text envelope.

undo.title: Undo continued session
undo.boundary: Only an unchanged new session can be undone. Source archives, attachments and migration records are retained.
undo.check_outcome: The outcome could not be confirmed. Refresh before continuing.
undo.unavailable: This session cannot currently be undone safely.
undo.confirmation: Undo this new session? Imported source materials will be retained.

reinterpretation.title: Reparse with the current parser
reinterpretation.boundary: Read the saved archive into a separate new interpretation. Original records, branches, attachments and created sessions stay unchanged. The source file is not read and historical tools are not executed.
reinterpretation.confirmation: Confirm to create a new record and start parsing. When complete, rebuild its branch and check continuation from that new record.
reinterpretation.unavailable: This archive cannot be reparsed right now. Refresh its state or upgrade the target.
reinterpretation.confirm: Create a new record and reparse

local_attachment.title: Supplement a local attachment
local_attachment.explanation: The historical path stays inactive. First prepare this reference, then choose a file on this device. Up to 256 MiB; transfers can be cancelled and explicitly resumed.
local_attachment.choose_same_file: Choose the same file to resume
local_attachment.unverified_original: This is user-supplied content. Equivalence to the historical original has not been verified.
local_attachment.failed: The operation was not confirmed. Refresh its status before explicitly retrying.
local_attachment.use_for_continuation: Use this explicitly supplied content for a new continuation
local_attachment.continuation_count: {{count}} explicitly selected local supplements will be included. They are not verified historical originals.

layers.updateRequired: This source does not support configuration-layer reports on this connection. Update the source KCoder and reconnect.
layers.title: Settings layer details
layers.boundary: Snapshot of the explicitly selected static files only. This is not the source application’s final runtime configuration. Values and source paths are never shown.
layers.failed: Layer details could not be read. Check the target connection and version, then reopen these details.
layers.not_applicable: This source does not have a settings-layer report.
layers.unavailable: This older record did not save a field-origin report. Its migration results remain unchanged.
layers.precedence: Precedence: user → project → project local. Missing files remain part of the selected snapshot; a later change requires an explicit rescan.

upload_collection.title: Collect upload staging
upload_collection.boundary: Remove only this upload’s original parts and assembly files. Keep final attachments, original history, audit records and source references. Legacy or user-modified data is not adopted.
upload_collection.confirmation: Confirm removal of staging originals still owned by this operation. Final attachments and original history remain. Completed deletions cannot be undone.
upload_collection.resume_confirmation: Restore the original plan and check the current upload only. This does not continue deletion; execution requires a separate confirmation.
upload_collection.working: Native service is checking or collecting staging.
upload_collection.scheduled: This connection accepted the task; awaiting Native execution status.
upload_collection.cancel_requested: Cancellation requested. Completed deletions retain their authoritative receipts.
upload_collection.retired: This staging no longer accepts content. Final attachments and history references remain.
upload_collection.progress: Verified deletion: {{bytes}} bytes; upload reservation returned: {{reserved}} bytes.
upload_collection.check_outcome: Outcome unconfirmed. Refresh the original record before deciding to resume. Deletion is never automatically replayed.

codex_layers.title: Codex project layer details
codex_layers.replacement: This selected model snapshot replaces single-file model selections. Review MCP separately; it is not merged here.
codex_layers.boundary: Selected trusted static files only; this does not establish the source process’s final configuration. CLI flags, process environment, managed policy and full Git/worktree runtime routing remain unobserved. Values and source paths are hidden.
codex_layers.precedence: User → explicitly selected profile → project root to working directory. The nearest supported model field wins. Project Provider/authentication/profile routing never becomes user authority.
codex_layers.ignored: Not adopted by this snapshot; routing authority is preserved

transferBrowser.title: Cross-device sources
transferBrowser.description: Choose the device containing Claude Code or Codex data. The device above remains the migration destination.
transferBrowser.login: Sign in to this source account in device connections, then refresh the device list.
transferBrowser.error: Could not read the source. Check the connection and account permissions, or disconnect before discovering again.
transferBrowser.releasePending: Source connection release is not confirmed. Retry disconnecting.
transferBrowser.partial: Some sources could not be read. This list does not represent all data.
transferBrowser.previewOnly: This discovers sources only. No data has been transferred or destination settings changed.
transferBrowser.targetLogin: Sign in to the destination account above before transferring data.
transferBrowser.updateRequired: The source does not support migration source type discovery. Update KCoder on the source, then reconnect.

lifecycle.view_confirmed: Read protection was just confirmed (up to 30 seconds; unconfirmed if disconnected)
lifecycle.view_unconfirmed: This page’s protection is unconfirmed. Check the connection.
lifecycle.view_expired: This page’s protection expired and will not reopen automatically.
lifecycle.view_released: This page’s read protection was released.
lifecycle.view_unsupported: This target does not support idle page protection yet.
lifecycle.view_legacy: Legacy archive retained; no managed birth authorizes collection.
lifecycle.retirement_boundary: Only unchanged archive content owned by this import is eligible. Source files, sessions, final attachments and migration audit are not automatically deleted. References and other readers retain their content. Prepare and resume only save control state; collection requires a separate explicit confirmation.
lifecycle.check_outcome: The original operation needs reconciliation. Refresh it without creating or replaying deletion.
lifecycle.legacy_retained: Legacy content remains retained because safe collection proof is unavailable.
lifecycle.references: {{count}} durable references still retain this content.
lifecycle.logically_retired: This import is logically retired; physical collection has a separate receipt.
lifecycle.still_active: This import is not logically retired.
lifecycle.collected_bytes: Confirmed removal of {{count}} archive bytes (not a filesystem free-block guarantee).
lifecycle.confirm_retire: Type {{word}} to retire and attempt collection. Only this page’s read hold is released; peer views and durable references remain protected.
lifecycle.confirm_resume: Type {{word}} to reconcile the original operation and resume control state. This does not delete content. Running still requires another explicit confirmation.
lifecycle.retired_body: This import is retired. Original import facts and retirement audit remain; archive bodies no longer open from this entry.
lifecycle.phase_blocked: Retained: conflict or safety proof unavailable
lifecycle.phase_outcome_unknown: Outcome unknown; reconcile the original operation
lifecycle.worker_stopped: No native execution owner currently holds the lease
lifecycle.worker_unknown: Execution owner unknown; this does not mean idle or not executed

errors.external_history_retirement_readers_busy: Another view or read object still protects this archive. Close it, then check again.
errors.external_history_retirement_referenced: Branches, attachments, preparations or sessions still reference this archive.
errors.external_history_retirement_execution_un: Execution proof is missing or changed. Explicit reconciliation is required; do not assume execution stopped.
Legacy control lacks execution birth proof and needs an explicit checked upgrade.
errors.external_history_retirement_resume_requi: Reconcile and resume the original operation before separately confirming execution.
errors.external_history_retirement_stale_sequen: The operation changed during confirmation. Refresh and confirm again.
errors.history_job_retirement_legacy_retained: Legacy archive has no managed collection proof and remains retained.
errors.history_job_retirement_archive_not_ready: Archive publication is not yet confirmed. Recover the original import first.
errors.history_view_release_unconfirmed: Release of this page’s protection is unconfirmed; collection was not started.
errors.external_history_lifecycle_busy: A read or control lease still holds the archive. Retain content and explicitly retry later.
errors.external_history_lifecycle_cancelled: Stop requested. Any completed retirement or removal facts remain in the original receipt.

transferStatus.notImported: This receipt confirms data reception only. It does not confirm that destination settings or assets have been imported.
transferStatus.error: The latest result could not be confirmed. Refresh reads the original operation without resubmitting the transfer.
transferStatus.disconnect: Disconnecting the source or leaving this page releases these connections. Data already received by the destination is retained.

transferRecords.title: Transfer recovery records
transferRecords.description: Recovery references saved by this browser. Queries connect only to the destination above and do not reread the source.
transferRecords.empty: No local recovery records for this destination.
transferRecords.error: Could not query the original operation. Check the destination connection and account; data will not be resent automatically.
transferRecords.invalid: Some local recovery references are damaged. They were retained and no request was sent for them.

transferHistory.boundary: Discover history on the selected source only. Select physical files explicitly; transfer preserves their original representation and provenance. Receiving data does not import conversations or replay historical tools.
transferHistory.catalogUnavailable: This history catalog is unavailable or could not be verified. Disconnect or discover again before selecting files; previous selections will not be submitted.
transferHistory.partialDiscovery: Discovery is incomplete. These are the sources actually found, not proof that all history is present.
transferHistory.partialPreview: Preview is incomplete; the original file can still be selected when Native import checks permit it.
transferHistory.blocked: Native checks block this source, for example because it exceeds the supported file size. It cannot be selected.

adoption.title: Review received sources for migration
adoption.boundary: Receiving and preview preparation do not save configuration or import history. Choose received sources explicitly; normal migration confirmation, save and undo follow in the existing workbench.
adoption.error: The original operation could not be confirmed. Read its status before proceeding.
adoption.map_workspace: Map this source project to the currently selected target workspace
adoption.workspace_required: Choose a target workspace before mapping project configuration or assets.
adoption.history_provenance: The historical project is provenance only; this does not map its path to the target.
adoption.unobserved: Original intent retained; Native result not observed
adoption.phase_cancelled: Preview preparation stopped; received data retained
adoption.phase_interrupted: Preview preparation interrupted; reconcile before resuming
adoption.phase_unknown: Preview outcome unknown; read the original operation
adoption.worker_stopped: No active Native worker was observed
adoption.control_unknown: Control ownership is unconfirmed. Resume and cancellation are unavailable.
adoption.poll_paused: Automatic status checks paused. Read the original status explicitly.
adoption.confirm: Type {{keyword}} to confirm control of this same preview operation. This does not save migration results.

sourceDirectory.explicit: Choose a product directory on the source device
sourceDirectory.path: Product directory on the source device (absolute path)
sourceDirectory.boundary: This is the selected source device’s Claude Code / Codex product directory, not this browser’s local directory. It authorizes static discovery only; project scanning still requires separate consent and trust. An unknown reply never falls back to home. Find again with the same input to reconcile the original choice, or disconnect the source first.
sourceDirectory.automatic: Use the source device’s configured product directories by default, without an additional directory grant.
sourceDirectory.absolute: Enter an absolute directory on the source device, without control characters or relative paths.
sourceDirectory.updateRequired: Upgrade the source runtime to authorize an explicit directory. No default-directory fallback was used.
sourceDirectory.failed: The directory choice or discovery is not yet confirmed. No home-directory fallback was used. Find again with the same input to reconcile the original choice, or disconnect the source first.

firstUse.title: Connect your first model
firstUse.description: This runtime target has not finished model configuration. Import connections and work material from Claude Code or Codex, or configure it manually. You can skip and continue browsing or creating empty tasks.
firstUse.import: Import from Claude Code or Codex
firstUse.incompleteTitle: A model connection still needs configuration
firstUse.incompleteDescription: Check credentials, model limits and the default selection in model settings. No default model is changed and no test request is sent automatically.
firstUse.targetUnavailable: The original runtime target or account changed. Import cannot continue on a different target. Close this dialog and confirm the target again.

definitionsPending: Source definitions stay pending by default. Static Agents can be explicitly adapted and enabled separately; Hooks remain pending.

definitionSource.boundary: Choose static definitions to copy as pending data. Transfer Ready only confirms received bytes; review and save them in the ordinary batch. No Agent, Hook, tool permission or system instruction is activated.
definitionSource.updateRequired: Update the source and destination to support passive definition migration.
definitionSource.failed: The selected definition sources could not be confirmed. Keep the original operation and check its state.
definitionSource.empty: No supported static definition sources were found.
definitionSource.partial: Some sources could not be inspected. I choose to copy only the explicitly listed sources.

historyFamilies.catalogUnavailable: This original history catalog expired or could not be verified. Discover again explicitly before selecting or transferring any physical entries.
historyFamilies.boundary: Explicitly index bounded first-record metadata before paging. This keeps observed ancestors together; it does not prove complete lineage or safe continuation. Basic browsing retains ten-item sampling. Every physical artifact remains an independent choice.
historyFamilies.limits: Up to 10,000 physical artifacts, 64 KiB per first record, 256 KiB compressed input per file and 64 MiB total input. Exhausted metadata budgets retain physical entries with incomplete diagnostics.
historyFamilies.updateRequired: Update the source/target to use the family index, or explicitly use basic browsing. No basic scan was started automatically.
historyFamilies.incomplete: The directory metadata index is incomplete. Original physical entries remain available; family relationships are display evidence only.
historyFamilies.parentObserved: The ancestor was observed on another page. Only explicitly selected physical entries will transfer.
historyFamilies.issue_missing_parent: The parent has not been observed in this catalog; the family remains unresolved.
historyFamilies.issue_conflict: Observed physical variants disagree about the parent. No family root is asserted.
historyFamilies.issue_cycle: A parent cycle was observed. No family root is asserted.
historyFamilies.issue_unobserved: Parent metadata is unavailable. This physical artifact remains independent.

problems.history_discovery_family_budget_exceeded: The family metadata budget was exhausted; physical entries remain listed.
problems.history_discovery_family_metadata_incomp: {{count}} session identifiers have incomplete first-record metadata.
problems.history_discovery_family_parent_conflict: {{count}} session identifiers have conflicting parent metadata.
problems.history_discovery_family_parent_missing: {{count}} referenced parent identifiers are missing from the catalog.

project_mcp.title: Keep inherited MCP servers
project_mcp.boundary: When adding the first project MCP declaration, choose which existing servers this project should keep. Only name references are saved; inherited credentials stay in their original configuration.
project_mcp.confirm: I confirm this selection, including keeping none when no servers are selected
project_mcp.failed: The inherited catalog could not be verified. Refresh it and select again.
project_mcp.upgrade: Update the target to select inherited MCP servers. Existing migration choices remain unchanged.

quickHistory.description: Find and import conversations while preserving originals and reusing previous imports. Supported embedded attachments are prepared too and may be sent to the model when you continue.

quickHistory.incomplete: This source could not be fully discovered. Conversations already found will still be processed.
quickHistory.dialogDescription: Bring conversations from Claude Code or Codex. Advanced options also import model connections, MCP servers, skills and other work.
